events.name: A Green Dedication

options.text: It is my great honor to rule cities as beautiful as [city] and have governors as wise as [character].
The people of [city] are its beauty, and the new grove will flourish thanks to their spirit.

events.text: Completion of the new Grove in [city] comes with a pleasant surprise. [character] decided to hold a ceremony dedicating this new, beautiful space to none other than you, [character]. What proclamation shall be issued in your name?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Al-Khazneh

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… In the shade of a valley close to [city], a mortuary tomb has been carved out of the vivid red sandstone, Al Khazneh. Each room within is carved with mythological figures while the elaborate facade captures the attention of every visitor. Even the urns are carved from the gentle stone, already leading to rumors that fabulous treasure resides within. Such a burial site will ensure that your name is recorded in the annals of history. People will flock to [city] to marvel at the skill and riches of your dynasty.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: All in Unity

options.text: There may be many gods, but there is one supreme being above all.
The worship of multiple gods is to be preserved.
[religion] has space for different schools of thought. Let the people worship how they please.

events.text: As [religion] evolves, some gods are beginning to take prominence. Shiva, Vishnu, Shakti, Ganesha, and Surya are each coming to the fore, with [character] and others worshiping varying ones of these deities as the supreme divine being. In [city], others are worshiping all five at once, along with a sixth symbolic god that represents the state of reality.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Ancient Statue

options.text: Put it on public display.
Disassemble it for stone.

events.text: Citizens in the quarries near [city] have unearthed a massive stone goliath! Its size and style suggest a culture with which our scholars are not familiar. What shall we do with the statue?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Conclusion to the Veda

options.text: This is a new age of [religion] thought.
Convene a gathering of the greatest minds of [religion].
Determine to shape the religion's future to your own ideas.

events.text: As the ideas of Monasticism spread through [rival], a quiet revolution is taking hold of [religion]. A collection of texts called the Upanishads are seeing a resurgence, being synthesized into a single corpus and used to compose a new form of the religion, moving past the rituals and sacrifices of the Vedas. These texts are already heralding a new age of [religion] as its followers debate the evolving ideas of the faith.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Cottage Decor

options.text: Fill them with lavish works of art.
Install busts of [family] ancestors.
Keep them austere for government use.

events.text: The construction of new dwellings near [city] gives the court designers an opportunity to show off their good taste. How shall they decorate?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Developing Traditions

options.text: Our courtiers will participate in a [religion] ceremony to forge a link between the religion and the royal court.
A full week of celebrations in [city] will be held to honor [religion].
I will hold a personal audience with the [religion] leaders of [city].

events.text: With the new place of [religion] worship opening its holy doors in [city], new traditions are developing among the faithful. A fire altar underneath a dome is at the center of this holy house. Worshipers will present their offerings to Ahura Mazda by placing them into the fire. How will the royal court acknowledge the new house of worship?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Dragon Bones

options.text: Dispatch a scout to search for similar bones.
Send wise men to investigate.
Send soldiers to protect the site from dragons.

events.text: Workers in one of the capital's quarries have excavated the bones of a gargantuan beast. Some have begun calling this creature a "dragon," and they claim it once walked the earth.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Dragon Bones

options.text: The bones have no value and should be destroyed.
Transport the bones to the city for further study.
Commission scribes to write epic dragon poetry.

events.text: Workers at the new quarry have discovered the bones of a colossal beast. They have asked the court to send scientists to the site, as they want someone of authority to inspect the giant bones they found to determine their origin. How shall we respond?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Dragon Bones

options.text: Dragon, which inspires new recruits to join the army.
Cloud serpent, and you order chariots to escort its spirit home.
Lizard of unknown origins, so the bones must be preserved.

events.text: Rumors swirl through the court that bones of the great "Beast of the Gods" were unearthed in a quarry not far from the palace. Your curiosity gets the best of you, so we arrange a visit to the quarry. Seeing the bones, you declare that they belong to a...

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Dragon Bones

options.text: Make an example of the older slaves until the rest return.
Sacrifice food to the gods in an appeal for safety.
Destroy the bones to free their evil spirits.
Give the bones to our wise men to study.

events.text: Workers in one of the capital's quarries have excavated the bones of a gargantuan beast. They have abandoned the site, spooked! Work has halted, and the quarry foreman is not sure how to proceed.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Epigraphic Reform

options.text: Ensure that all inscriptions are updated.
Argue that communication between the clergy results in enough of the rules being followed.

events.text: It has become common practice for the temples and shrines of [rival] to be adorned with epigraphic texts, especially stone and metal inscriptions that describe the laws and codes for the workings of the priests and temples. Some of the priests are arguing that a formal system should be introduced to ensure that these are kept up to date with changes within the religious thought.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Epigraphic Reform

options.text: Ensure that all inscriptions are updated.
Argue that communication between the clergy results in enough of the rules being followed.

Some of the priests are arguing that a formal system should be introduced to ensure that these are kept up to date with changes within the religious thought.

Some of the priests are arguing that a formal system should be introduced to ensure that these are kept up to date with changes within the religious thought.

options.text: Ensure that all inscriptions are updated.
Argue that communication between the clergy results in enough of the rules being followed.

Some of the priests are arguing that a formal system should be introduced to ensure that these are kept up to date with changes within the religious thought.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Fire of Fires

options.text: Donate your hearth embers.
Refuse.

events.text: As is tradition, the sacred fire of the new Temple Zoroastrianism in [city] is being built by one representative of each social class donating embers from their hearth fire. [character] has suggested that you donate embers from the palace. This symbolic gesture would please the people but would associate you with the other donors.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Fire of Verethraghna

options.text: Keep them, Zoroaster only worshipped before the flame.
The fires ensure our victory, Verethraghna fights for us against the dark.
A statue would let the faithful see Ahura Mazda.

events.text: An eternal fire burns inside every [religion] temple, fed by the Magi and blessed by the prayers said before it. The greatest fires are created for the Cathedral Zoroastrianism, each one consecrated and dedicated to Verethraghna the god of victory. Yet there is currently no fire within the new Cathedral Zoroastrianism of [city]. When pressed, the Magi explain that they are debating whether there is still a place for the sacred fire, or if the worship of statues and images has made it redundant. Should the fires be kept alive?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Fisher Expertise

options.text: Let the Fisherman teach [character] how to manage a fishing operation.
Put the Fisherman in charge of training Fisher Specialists at [city].

events.text: While on an inspection tour of new work boats at [city], [character] is befriended by a lower-ranking [family] elder, who has been fishing these waters for decades.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Gladiator Games

options.text: Yes, fund a cohort of combatants.
Blood should not be sport.

requirements.label: Soldier / Warlike / Fierce
tip: The leader must have one of: Soldier; Warlike; Fierce

options.text: I will train them myself!

events.text: With the completion of Theater 3 in [city], the head of the [family] family, [character], encourages us to hold games for Gladiators in the city as entertainment for all.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Hagia Sophia

options.text: It will be a house of worship for [religion].
[religion] shall find a home here.
Make it open to all as a public building.

events.text: Nothing like the Hagia Sophia of [city] has ever been built in the known world. It is a marvel of architectural genius and artistic beauty, a true testament to the divine. What religion should call the Hagia Sophia its seat, the crown jewel of its spiritual influence?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Heliopolis

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… Known by many names, the sun’s favor is a necessary boon for any dynasty. With the construction of Heliopolis this favor is assured. [city], dubbed by some as ‘the City of the Sun’, is now dominated by this complex of temples to the gods of [rival]. Inspiring all who see them, the monumental temples of Heliopolis will stand as a symbol of your nation’s devotion to the gods, inspiring awe for ages to come.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Holy Site Christianity

options.text: Our name will reach the heavens.

events.text: It is done… Standing on the site of the crucifixion of Jesus, at the heart of the stone church lies a rotunda housing the tomb where he was laid to rest before the resurrection. You step into the cool shade of the entrance and lift your eyes to the light spilling into the dome, filling the chamber with an aura of reverence and awe. Holy Site Christianity will stand as a beacon for the Christianity faithful.
events.triggerData: The Church of the Holy Sepulchre

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Holy Site Judaism

options.text: Our name will reach the heavens.

events.text: It is done… Flanked by the gold twin pillars, the temple is a site of wonder and fascination. The courtyard offers a tranquil space away from the noisy streets outside as the music of hymns intermingles with the hushed whispers of priests and the noises of animals taken for sacrifice. Incense drifts out to you from the inner chambers and even deeper inside lies the holy space that only the High Priest may enter, the holy space where God now dwells among your people. Holy Site Judaism will stand as a beacon for the Judaism faithful.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Holy Site Manichaeism

options.text: Our name will reach the heavens.

events.text: It is done… Surrounded by a grove of trees, the granite temple houses the resident priests upstairs, with space to worship below. The grounds of the temple create an environment of reflection and tranquillity to draw closer to the teachings of Mani, with the many hued stone statue of the holy prophet sitting at the center of the temple. Holy Site Manichaeism will stand as a beacon for the Manichaeism faithful.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Holy Site Zoroastrianism

options.text: Our name will reach the heavens.

events.text: It is done… The undying holy fire of Ahura Mazda has been brought to its new home in the mountaintop temple, sitting on a peak where it can be seen for miles around. Although remote, the temple already beckons the faithful who seek pilgrimage and the fierce heat can be felt from even outside of the temple. Holy Site Zoroastrianism will stand as a beacon for the Zoroastrianism faithful.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Inscriptions to Ahura Mazda

options.text: Praise to Ahura Mazda.
My family and deeds.
The laws that rule us all.
Ahura Mazda rules through me. Combine the two versions.

events.text: With the construction of the new Courthouse 1 of [city] complete, the Master Stoneworker has sought an audience about the inscription. He has received two conflicting orders, your Court Minister [character] drafted an inscription declaring your greatness and praising your lineage, but [character] argues that the inscriptions should be about Ahura Mazda. What should the Stoneworkers put on the new Courthouse 1?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Jade Empires

options.text: Trade for their royal seals and other items of the court.
Trade for ceremonial artifacts.
Learn their methods for uncovering the precious material.

events.text: The new Market 1 of [city] has attracted an unusual clientele. Merchants from a distant empire to the East have arrived with vast quantities of Jade.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: No Place to Rest

options.text: Pay for the rest of the land to be returned to the [family].
Retort that the [family] willingly sold the ground.
Appeal to [character] sense of duty.

events.text: Your courtier [character] has been making a tidy profit in [city]. After a foolish deal by the [family] saw them selling much of the ground suitable for traditional burials to the merchant, [character] has been selling it back to the [family] at a high profit. City expansion means that burial ground is becoming increasingly scarce and expensive, and the [family] ask for you to intervene.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Overflowing with Hate

options.text: Stop the pagans from using the bath area.
Allow free entry to all.
Build a new pool and temple complex, specifically for the curses.

events.text: The opening of the Baths 2 in [city] is supported by the of [religion], who have associated the springs with a local goddess. The benefits of this divine patronage are dubious as reports soon arrive that the pagan community of the city have started to throw lead curse tablets into the water, hoping that the messages will spur the goddess to take vengeance on their enemies. [character] is particularly upset, saying that the hordes of pagans have driven off a promising doctor he was hoping would work at the baths.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Precious Metals

options.text: Add it to the treasury.
Beautify the city.

events.text: In a stroke of good luck, a cache of precious metals has been discovered in the new Mine near [city]. How should we use this unexpected boon?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Protector of the Borderlands

rewards.text: Gain trait: Commander of the BorderLands

options.text: A good idea, but let's promote from within our own family. We'll give [character] a title to keep his mind off of matters of succession.
I see no reason to create a new title at this time. Enough with this foolishness.

events.text: With an increasing number of forts dotting the Borderlands, you've begun to overhear conversations in Court about the possibility of creating an honorific title and giving it to a deserving noble. There may be something to that idea. What do you want to do?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Public Scrolls

options.text: The works of our playwrights are inspiring.
Scrolls that describe the motions of stars and planets belong in the library.
Accounts of past wars and battles fought can teach about the fights to come.

events.text: The new Library 1 in [city] stands ready to welcome everyone who wishes to learn. In time, it could become one of the finest places of learning in all of [rival]. Your own reputation as a refined scholar precedes you, and the Library 1 will be all the more prestigious if you allow a few works from your own collection to be moved there. What should we make available to the people of [city]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Religious Tithes

options.text: Give them what they ask.
Give extra as thanks for their support.
Refuse to pay.

events.text: Even the most pious need material resources to support their places of worship, the [religion] plaintiff insists. She claims that the crown owes tithes for the use of religious land. How shall we respond to this demand?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Sacred Land

options.text: We will pay the fine.
The Oracle is but a relic of the old ways, we shall not pay.

events.text: The pagan priests of Oracle deplored the new construction in [city], which they claim is on their sacred land. As is their right, they have imposed a fine for use of the land.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Statue of God

options.text: Find and punish those that created the statue.
Assure [character] that it won’t happen again.
Place the statue in the temple.

events.text: The construction of the Temple Judaism of [city] is met with joy. The people flock into the streets and parade around late into the night. However, you later hear that in the midst of the celebration a statue was carried around with a group of people proclaiming it to be the image of God. [character] is worried that [city] has fallen into the practice of idolatry, but it could just be fervor and revelry going too far.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Tanit

options.text: Sacrifice to Tanit, mother goddess and Face of Ba'al.
Sacrifice to Melqart, the Lord of Tyre and Protector of the Universe.
Sacrifice to Ba'al Hammon, consort of Tanit and Lord of the Two Horns.

events.text: Although Melqart has often been praised as the highest of gods, in recent years a different god has laid claim to the title. The goddess Tanit's icon of a circle above a triangle is now seen across the nation in inscriptions, mosaics and jewelry. The [family] family, traditionally staunch followers of Melqart, have asked who you will be sacrificing to for [rival]'s aid.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Acropolis

options.text: The [family] family.
The [family] family.
The [family] family.

events.text: Acropolis is complete! Each of our vassal families wishes to dedicate a sacred treasury inside the monument. Which family shall receive this honor?

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Acropolis

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... Rising above the [city] skyline, Acropolis stands as a powerful symbol of the [rival] world. The rocky outcrop’s walls of stone serve as natural protection against attackers, protecting this center of governance. Such a prominent position lends a natural association with the divine, and Acropolis has become a home of the gods with temples to the gods of [rival] adorning the ridge. This symbolic bastion will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Apadana

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... A grand audience hall, Apadana of [city] is an impressively ornate display of power and dynastic legitimacy. To reach the main hall, a visitor must climb monumental stairs adorned with intricate reliefs of battling lions and the supplication of subject nations bringing gifts before the [title]. The hall itself is estimated to house ten thousand people, with seventy-two columns carved with bulls holding a wooden ceiling high above the [rival] throne. This regal hall will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Circus Maximus

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… Circus Maximus of [city] is the largest Circus in the world, a site for chariot racing, hosting public games and religious festivals. Legend says that the site was originally used by the founder of [rival] as a dirt track, but the new site consists of marvelous stands made from stone. Spectators aim to be as close to the action as possible, with seats for the wealthiest and most important spectators being built right onto the edge of the track. This grand arena will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Circus Maximus

options.text: Plan for the bloodiest gladiatorial combat.
Hold plays of high culture and drama.

events.text: Workers roar their approval, as the last stone is set in place. Circus Maximus is finally finished! The impressive venue, 2,000 feet long and 400 feet wide, will host all future public festivals and events. The possibilities are limitless.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Colosseum

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… There is nothing like it, being in the crowd as a thousand voices cry out in shared elation. Colosseum provides entertainment for the masses, bringing young and old, rich and poor together on the cool stone steps to revel in the lavish spectacles you support: fights, executions, parades of animals, even filling the arena with water for naval re-enactments. This monument to the glory of [rival] will not be forgotten. The lavish displays of your dynasty will be remembered through the ages.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Colosseum

options.text: A natural tableau with wild flora and fauna.
An artificial flooding for naval reenactments.
The executions of political prisoners.

events.text: Visible all across the city, the Theater 3 will play host to a wide variety of public events. However, the spirit of these spectacles must be established soon. The rabble have already taken to the streets of [city] to claim the arena for executions and bloodsport. The court has several ideas for an inaugural event.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Colossus

options.text: Host a military parade and address the army.
Dedicate the statue to a family ancestor.
Raise the sculptor to the nobility.

events.text: A vast crowd has gathered in [city] to witness the unveiling of the massive statue that you had commissioned. It towers many feet above the city, throwing a mighty shadow. How shall we mark the occasion?

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Colossus

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... Standing astride the trading port of [city], Colossus is a 33 meter depiction of the sun god, created by folding vast sheets of bronze over a large iron frame. Sailors gaze in awe as the gleaming figure appears over the horizon, welcoming merchants back home. This grand statue will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Cothon

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… Harbors cling to the coasts across the world, but none compare to Cothon. Sailing in on the royal barge, your architects point out how there is space for hundreds of ships to be docked at once, split between the rectangular area for merchant ships and the circular gated section that is reserved for military use. With this harbor, your claim on the seas of the world has been made. [rival] will forever be known as a naval power to be feared and respected.

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Hagia Sophia

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… The basilica of Hagia Sophia is the first to use a pendentive dome, a revolutionary technique that allows the dome to stand without any pillars. The effect of the building is already making itself known as different religions adopt this feature that creates such a lasting impression of the sacred and the divine. This holy space will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Hanging Gardens

options.text: Nature provides the best kind of peace.
Plants hold many healing properties.
We should celebrate life more often.

events.text: Strolling in our magnificent new gardens has given members of the court many ideas. Which of these musing should we act upon?

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Hanging Gardens

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... Hanging Gardens of [city] are a marvel of horticulture and engineering. The great building is a giant vertically-tiered garden with plants gathered from across the world, with water being raised and distributed through a complex system of machinery. The tales of the garden are already spreading through other nations, with many claiming that such a marvel is too incredible to be true. These elusive and enticing gardens will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Hill Fort

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done…. The walls of Hill Fort stand guard above the city of [city], providing comfort and stability for the people around. The relief it provides is not just defense; inside the fortifications are temples, palaces, artificial lakes, and monuments of victory. Military might and cultural beauty meet in perfect harmony. With the fort complete, your control of the surrounding lands is secured. Your people may rest easy. Hill Fort will be a bastion to weather all storms.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Ishtar Gate

options.text: I shall paint it myself.
Hire the most famous among them.
Let local children decorate it.

events.text: Now that Ishtar Gate has been built, artists from all over the nation have come to ask permission to paint it. Who should receive this great honor?

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Ishtar Gate

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... Around the inner city of [city] Ishtar Gate stands guard over the most sacred of routes, the Processional Way, an important part of the new year celebrations. An inscription on the gate says how the workers ‘thus adorned them with luxurious splendor so that Mankind might gaze on them in wonder’, and how wondrous they are! The clay bricks are glazed with a brilliant blue hue and covered with reliefs of bulls, dragons, lions and other sacred animals. These gates will stand as a testament to our people for all time.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Jebel Barkal

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… The mesa of Jebel Barkal cuts an imposing figure from the sky, commanding the attention of even the gods. Your architects and builders have finished an equally impressive complex of temples, palaces, and tombs gathered around the base of the mountain. Together, these create a place that is soon renown as a most holy site, a center of power for the priests of the divine. The temples of Jebel Barkal create a religious center that will influence the world for generations to come. All will know of the piety and devotion of your dynasty.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Jerwan Aqueduct

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… Water is the lifeblood of any city, one that you have brought to [city] with the construction of Jerwan Aqueduct. Innumerable limestone blocks have been cut, trimmed and lifted into position to form grand arches of stone carrying a channel of water across rock and valley alike. Moving water is normally an act of the divine, but you have shown that such a feat is well within your power. Your influence and glory will be remembered across the ages, as will the gift of water that you have given to your people.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Lighthouse

options.text: Mighty warships and military transports.
Vast barges laden with fruit and grain.
Beautiful vessels full of luxury goods.

events.text: With an otherworldly glow, the lighthouse near [city] ignites its great beacon, beckoning distant ships toward its harbor. Which kind of ships do we wish us to attract?

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Lighthouse

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... Navigating the seas of the world is a perilous undertaking. The ports that can afford to use lighthouses to help navigation, but none are as magnificent as Lighthouse of [city]. It stands on an islet opposite the city harbor, over 100 meters of white-washed stone with stairs winding up around the outside near the base and inside further up. At the tip is an oil lamp, as wood can be scarce, that is reflected across the sea with mirrors. This beacon will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Mahavihara

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… The Mahavihara has opened its doors to the monks and scholars of [rival], a dedicated center of learning and gathering of the world’s greatest minds. In the shade of the monumental brick structures, the finest scholars debate and dissect religion, mathematics, natural sciences, and anything else that catches their endless curiosity. Their ideas are soon spreading across the lands, forming a new age of thought and enlightenment. This university of learning is a monument to knowledge, one that shows the culture and insight of your dynasty. The discoveries made here will shape the world.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Mausoleum

options.text: My love, [character], will make this his eternal home.
The name of my heir, [character] will never by forgotten.
Only a leader of my stature is fit for such a tomb.

events.text: Your royal family attends the unveiling of the completed Mausoleum, a glorious royal tomb that towers 150 feet high and boasts carvings by the greatest artists of the age. The structure will stand as a symbol of your lasting legacy. You gaze at your family and feel a rush of pride.

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Mausoleum

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... Death and legacy is an ever present concern for rulers, and your dynasty’s response is so dramatic that the name is already starting to being used for other grand tombs. The building is a stunning undertaking, a mix of architectural features from different nations topped with a giant chariot-riding statue depicting yourself as a mythological hero riding to war. Around Mausoleum is a garden with over a hundred statues, one courtier quipping that if the city is in danger there would be enough stone to build a new set of walls. Mausoleum will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Monumental Buddhas

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… Carved directly into the cliffs, Monumental Buddhas watch over the roads of [city]. Merchants stop and pray for protection on their travels, visiting the smaller chapel caves that surround the carvings. Such an achievement of art and construction is only possible through the mix of skills that Buddhism has brought together. As well as stone carving, the details are made from a mixture of mud and straw, the figures then painted with stucco coloring. Monumental Buddhas will stand as a testament to your piety, a record that will ensure that your name is remembered through the ages.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Musaeum

options.text: An extensive library with a scribe.
An observatory with a philosopher.
An anatomy lab with a physician.

events.text: Engineers have finished the main stages of the Musaeum, an institution for national learning and enlightenment. Now the court proposes new ideas to further specialize the complex with additional spaces and scholars. How shall we spend remaining funds?

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Musaeum

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… The ‘Place of the Muses’ in [city] is not a single building but a complex of shrines, observatories, gardens, a zoo and, most famously, a library. Musaeum houses over a hundred scholars for researching and cataloging, making copies of any text that comes through the bustling city and keeping the original in the library. Musaeum will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Necropolis

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... Necropolis of [city] is a sprawling system of temples and tombs for the [title]s of [rival], with imposing statues and mortuary temples lined along the base of the surrounding hills. Each member of your dynasty has a temple built to honor their reign and to serve as a center for their mortuary cult, with tombs cut into the rock of the hills behind in an area that locals have started to call the Valley of the [title]s. This grand funerary site will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of the dynasty’s accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: The Open Air

options.text: The open air is exactly what I need.
Let us speak of the future.

events.text: As the herders of [city] become more settled and prosperous, one of the wealthy landowners invites you out on a tour of her estates.

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Oracle

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... To pagan [rival], Oracle of [city] is the center of the world. The temple area is built on the slopes of a sacred mountain, the site where they believe a god slew the gargantuan snake Python. Now priestesses, the Pythia, inhale smoke and divine prophesies from their god, answering the questions of supplicants. The sacred way that leads up the mountain is adorned with displays of art and wealth as the families compete to show their dedication and wealth. This sacred site will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Oracle of [city]

options.text: Only I deserve this privilege.
Those who can afford the fee.
The gods should be heard by everyone!

events.text: Oracle has been completed, and those who tend it will speak with the authority of the gods. There is much for us to ask. Who should we allow to consult with the Oracle?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Oracle of [city]

options.text: The high priestess has lost her mind.
It is vague. We should proceed with caution.
The gods favor us! Pay the Oracle handsomely.

events.text: We consulted the Pythia of the Oracle, and this is her prophecy: "You have come to my rich temple as a mortal dear to the gods. I am in doubt whether to pronounce you mortals or gods, but I think rather you are a god." What does it mean?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Pantheon

options.text: Icons of our royal line.
Statues of the gods.
Busts of... me.

events.text: Pantheon's vaulted ceiling rises over the rooftops, an apotheosis inspired by the heavens above. Visitors walk the rotunda, exploring the empty halls and niches. Somehow, the structure feels incomplete. We should fill the space with the nation's most revered symbols.

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Pantheon

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… Pantheon of [city] has been finished on the third attempt after the first two were destroyed by fires, the second caused by being struck by lightning. The wide circular structure creates an impressive space where the gods can be worshiped equally, with recesses holding statues of the different pagan gods of [rival]. This temple will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Pyramids

options.text: They are a testament to hard work.
Our legacy will last forever.
Death is not the end, but a beginning...

events.text: As you stare up at the majesty of the completed Pyramids, your heir, [character], asks you what they mean. How will you respond?

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Pyramids

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... Pyramids of [city] tower above the surrounding lands, the polished stone gleaming in the sun. A labor force of a hundred thousand workers have cut and raised over two million blocks of stone to create the monolithic structures, with intricate tombs and passages hidden behind the unyielding stone surface. This is a burial site truly worthy of the [title] of [rival], one that will stand as a testament to our people for all time and be a symbol of the glory and power of your dynasty.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Royal Library

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… The world has never before seen such a collection of knowledge in one place. Poetry, academic treaties, writings on statecraft, and diplomatic records have been brought to Royal Library to provide a record of the world in. Of particular pride is a copy of the original tale of. This collection of knowledge and literature is a true accomplishment, one that marks [rival] place in the world. The writings of your people will last for all eternity.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: The Sport of Kings

options.text: Indeed, I believe the laws can be improved.
Done? Those hunters have made [city] prosperous, they set an example.
Alas, you have my sympathies. More wine?

events.text: On a social call to [character], the conversation turns sour in the aftermath of an unsuccessful hunt. "I'm sure it must be those peasants with bows that are everywhere these days, surely something can be done?"

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Stupa

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… Stupa of [city] is a place of calm and pious reflection away from the chaos of the city, a place to house the relics of your people. The once humble site has grown over the years, with people from all walks of life donating their money to help fund the growing complex. Close by, a pillar stands as a statement of your achievements and your ambition, the first of many Pillar Edict. It is a promise of the past and the future; telling the history of your dynasty and the dharma of your rule, how all should expect to be treated.

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Via Recta Souk

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... Via Recta Souk is already bustling with merchants and traders from every corner of the world, meeting in [city] to trade their wares and their stories. The narrow streets are lined with stalls selling every luxury and good known to man. This thriving hub will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: The Works of [character]

options.text: North, of course. [character], would you like to advise on the further agricultural development of [city]?
I think you will find I am more than capable of managing [rival] Grove and plantations.

events.text: The people of [rival] have known the ways of the land since time immemorial. Yet, to comprehensively compile that knowledge? To document and consider each aspect? That has brought [character] the kind of respect and acclaim for him to advise even [character]. He says you should really point these Grove facing north.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Yazilikaya

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done… The very rocks of [city] have been carved into a monument to the gods of [rival] in the structure now known as Yazilikaya. The various chambers hewn out of the side of the mountain build an intricate model of the cosmos with rooms dedicated to the earth, the sky, and the underworld, their placement by your architects forming a lunisolar calendar that marks the ordained time for religious festivals by the movement of the sun and the moon through the rooms. Such precise architecture is a true sign of dedication to the gods. Word of your accomplishment is already spreading. The world will remember the piety and artistic prowess of [rival].

events.author: Soren Johnson, Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Ziggurat

options.text: With this wonder, my legacy will endure.

events.text: It is done... Great Ziggurat of [city] is an incredible feat of engineering that will survive the ravages of time and war. Even the base layer of the stepped pyramid towers 30 meters above the surrounding lands, built of over 700,000 mud baked bricks. The pyramid lies at the center of a temple complex, and at the pinnacle is a temple to the gods of [rival]. This center of culture and religion will stand as a testament to our people for all time, a symbol of our accomplishments today and of the glories yet to come.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Ziggurat of [city]

options.text: Dedicate this shrine to Love.
Dedicate this shrine to Wisdom.
Dedicate this shrine to War.

events.text: Gathering your closest advisors and priests, you climb the towering monument. With every terrace, you feel your connection to the heavens strengthen. The lands of [rival] stretch in every direction. Your domain. As priests begin prayers on the topmost terrace, they ask for your blessing. Shall this be a shrine to Love, Wisdom, or War?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Tragedy, oh Tragedy

options.text: Hire the poet for our court.
Personally commission the next play yourself.
Stop the play from being shown.

events.text: A poet of great renown has written a new tragedy to be performed at the Theater 1 of [city]. The poet has reworked a number of [rival] myths, placing the hubris of man and the justice of the gods at the fore. The gods are shown to be stern and unyielding to the plight of the people tossed around by fate. One scene in particular shows to be unrelentingly cruel. Despite the criticism of the priests, the poet promises that it is merely a part of a narrative arc, where they will become benign protectors of the worthy in the next play.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Tutorial: Trade Network

options.text: I will extend my Trade Network to gain more Money and increase Happiness!

events.text: You've built your first Hamlet! A Hamlet and its upgrades, Village and Town, will produce extra Money if brought into your Trade Network! Bringing a city into your Trade Network will increase Happiness there. The Trade Network consists of all Tiles connected to your Capital City. Cities and Hamlet can be connected with one another via Road, River, Urban Tiles, and even open water. You can connect a City to its Harbor with a Road. You can check the Trade Network overlay with the icon(MAP_OVERLAY_NETWORK) button on the left edge of the mini-map, or the hotkey(HOTKEY_SHOW_TRADE_NETWORK) key, and verify that a City is Connected to the Trade Network by checking that the icon(CONNECTED) icon is displayed under its City Banner.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Tutorial: Training

options.text: I will train my Melee Units at a Barracks so they gain more Xp!

events.text: You've built your first Barracks! Melee Units that remain Idle on a Barracks will earn Xp. There is a similar bonus for idle Ranged Units on a Range. Unit Promotion are cheaper for Units with more Xp, so make sure to train your Units while not at war to keep them sharp!

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: View from the Throne

options.text: Invite delegations to pay tribute.
Let the common people come.

tip: As leader: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Siege
As leader: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Ship

options.text: I wish to enjoy the view alone.

events.text: With the completion of the sprawling, majestic Apadana, we have constructed a royal hall that will span the ages. We should hold an event to celebrate this mighty achievement. Engineers believe the main hall and porticos will accommodate up to 10,000.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Warm Relations

options.text: The [family].
The [family].
The [family].

events.text: Noble families are lining up to be the first to take advantage of the recently completed baths. Time together would provide a perfect opportunity to discuss alliances and win support. To which family should we extend this prized invitation?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Warriors of Truth

options.text: Our most experienced fighters should be in charge of the training.
The key is day after day of long training so they are always prepared.

events.text: [city] stands ready to train [rival] warriors. Being from a city of strong [religion] tradition, these warriors will be more than fighters for [rival] - they will also fight for Ahura Mazda, for Asha - for truth itself. This is a high calling and a noble task. What can we do to prepare these warriors in the best way possible?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Where Old Bones Lie

options.text: Order parts of the site be reconstructed to protect the holy ground.
Allow the building to stand but only allow building on [religion] ground with permits.
Refuse the request for more regulation.

events.text: The construction works in [city] have accidentally strayed onto holy ground, uncovering the bones of the buried. [character] comes before the court to ask for strict protection for [religion] ground to the discontent of the [family] family. How will you placate these disturbed souls?
